name: World Bank Indicators API
description: About 16,000 time series for every country and aggregate region - GDP, population, emissions, literacy, life expectancy, energy use - most running from 1960 to the most recent reporting year. No key, stable URLs, and the same query shape for every indicator, which makes it the easiest cross-country panel to assemble.

access.pagination: page= and per_page= (max 32,500). The JSON response is a two-element array: [metadata, rows].

recipes.title: One indicator for every country, all years

gotchas.trap: The top level is [metadata, data], so d[0] is paging info and d[1] is the rows. Iterating d directly gives you two useless objects.
country/all includes aggregates - World, OECD, Euro area - alongside real countries, which double-counts any sum.
gotchas.fix: Filter on the region.id field; aggregates carry region.id == 'NA'.

gotchas.trap: Missing years are present with value null rather than omitted.
